name: UI Suite USWDS Paragraphs
description: A suite of Paragraph bundles built around the UI Suite USWDS (US Web Design System) components.
project_description:
UI Suite USWDS Paragraphs is a helper module for UI Suite USWDS . Goal is to provide pre-configured USWDS paragraph bundles as a starter point for using USWDS components that are leveraging the UI Suite.

 Back to top 

 USWDS Components provided 
 
 Accordion 
 
 Alert 
 Cards 
 Collections 
 Hero Banner 
 Icon List 
 Modal 
 Process List 
 Step Indicator 
 Summary box 
 
 More to come!!

 Back to top 

 Branches 
 3.0.x is built around USWDS 3.x library and UI Suite USWDS 3.0.x (which is built around UI Patterns 1.x).

3.1.x will eventually be made which will follow UI Suite USWDS 3.1.x (which is built around UI Patterns 2.x).
